name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
provenance: aurasoph/lean-refactor public warm-up comparator; objective 112.37, 188 tokens, 1429 HB
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  suffices ∀ S, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars post ⊆ S → h1 ∈ S →
      Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars
        (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post) ⊆ S by
    exact this _ (List.subset_append_left _ _) (by simp)
  induction post
  all_goals simp only [substOld, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  case const | op | bvar | fvar => exact fun _ hs _ => hs
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case quant ih₁ ih₂ | eq ih₁ ih₂ =>
    intro S hs hh
    exact List.append_subset.mpr
      ⟨ih₁ S (List.append_subset.mp hs).1 hh,
        ih₂ S (List.append_subset.mp hs).2 hh⟩
  case ite ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ =>
    intro S hs hh
    simp only [List.append_subset] at hs ⊢
    exact ⟨⟨ih₁ S hs.1.1 hh, ih₂ S hs.1.2 hh⟩, ih₃ S hs.2 hh⟩
  case app ih₁ ih₂ =>
    intro S hs hh
    split
    · split
      · simpa [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] using hh
      · exact hs
    · exact List.append_subset.mpr
        ⟨ih₁ S (List.append_subset.mp hs).1 hh,
          ih₂ S (List.append_subset.mp hs).2 hh⟩

label: pointwise_future_join
name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
provenance: local residual repair: compile recursive union transport once as a propositional join and isolate only substOld's exceptional app branch
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  intro x
  have join {a b c d : Prop} (ha : a → c ∨ x = h1) (hb : b → d ∨ x = h1) :
      a ∨ b → (c ∨ d) ∨ x = h1 := by
    rintro (h | h)
    · exact (ha h).imp Or.inl id
    · exact (hb h).imp Or.inr id
  induction post <;>
    simp only [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
      Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at *
  case const | op | bvar | fvar => exact Or.inl
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case quant ih₁ ih₂ | eq ih₁ ih₂ => exact join ih₁ ih₂
  case ite ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ => exact join (join ih₁ ih₂) ih₃
  case app ih₁ ih₂ =>
    split
    · split
      · simp_all [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
      · exact Or.inl
    · exact join ih₁ ih₂
